explanation: In Brazil, slurping noodles is considered impolite because it violates the local dining etiquette that values quiet, discreet eating. Brazilian culture typically views loud eating noises as a lack of manners, especially in formal or semi-formal restaurant settings.
local_tip: If you must eat noodles, twirl them quietly on your fork and avoid making any slurping sounds to show respect for local customs.

also_check.note: Slurping noodles is a sign of enjoyment and appreciation for the chef in Japan.
Slurping noodles is common and indicates you are savoring the meal, though very loud slurping may be seen as crude in formal settings.
Slurping any pasta is considered extremely rude and uncivilized in Italy, where quiet, deliberate eating is the norm.
